title: Grade Calculator
description:
```
How many scores? 4
Score 1: 88
Score 2: 92
Score 3: 79
Score 4: 95
Average: 88.5  →  Grade: B+
Highest: 95  Lowest: 79
```
hints: `while (score < 0 || score > 100) { ... ask and read again ... }` right after the first read keeps asking until the score is valid.
`static_cast<double>(sum) / count` gives the average with its decimals. Then one chain of `if (average >= 97) ... else if (average >= 93) ...` picks the grade, from the highest band down.
requirements: Track sum, min, max while reading (no arrays needed!)
